Title: Clock-in accepted at 12:44:30 for a 13:00 visit; the window check compared whole minutes and dropped seconds
Resolution: Window now compared on full UTC timestamps. BVA rows with seconds (12:44:30) added to TC-EVV-001.

Title: Back-to-back visits (09:00-11:00, then 11:00-12:00 at the same address) flagged as a caregiver overlap hard block
Resolution: Visit intervals treated as half-open [start, end). Overlap and travel-buffer BVA rows (10:59, 11:00, 11:14, 11:15) added.

Title: A visit of 112 min 50 s billed as 8 units: seconds were rounded up to 113 min before the 15-minute rule
Resolution: BR-047 did not say how partial minutes count. BA laid out the options and the claim impact for the Product Owner and the Compliance and Privacy Officer; decision recorded in the decision log: billable minutes are whole elapsed minutes, seconds truncated. BR-047 clarified in SRS v1.2; code aligned; TC-BIL-002 row added.

Title: Coordinator scoped to Lakemont South opened a Lakemont North client by a direct GET /clients/{clientId}
Resolution: Location filter added to the client repository; a policy test now runs every location-scoped route with an out-of-scope user. Hotfix verified within the S1 SLA.

Title: Holiday hours paid an overtime premium on top of the holiday premium; overtime attributed to the Monday holiday hours instead of the last hours of the workweek
Resolution: Full report in defect-report-example.md. Allocation made chronological; premium = highest applicable multiplier per minute. BA added a premium-selection decision table to business-rules.md (SRS v1.2).

Title: PRN dose exactly 24 hours after the oldest dose in the window was blocked; the rolling-window boundary was undefined
Resolution: BA and the Clinical SME defined the rolling window as the 24 hours before the new dose, excluding a dose given exactly 24 hours earlier: (t - 24 h, t]. Note added to BR-033 in SRS v1.2; boundary rows added to TC-MAR-007.

Title: Daily overtime profile also counted daily-overtime hours toward the weekly 40 hours: a 4 x 10 h + 4 h week paid 12.0 h overtime instead of 8.0 h
Resolution: CR-001 added the daily profile but not its interaction with weekly overtime. BA ran a 30-minute decision session (Product Owner, Engineering Lead, Compliance and Privacy Officer): hours paid as daily OT or DT do not count toward the weekly 40 hours; no hour carries two premiums. Note added to BR-041 in SRS v1.2; engine cases PR-06 and PR-07 added.

Title: Out-of-range vital alert was held until 07:00 by quiet hours
Resolution: The provisioning seed of the notification event catalog marked VITAL_OUT_OF_RANGE as non-urgent. Seed corrected; a provisioning test now asserts the urgent flag for every BR-053 event.

Title: Schedule board week view took 3.4 s at p95 with 500 visits (target 2.5 s)
Resolution: N+1 query on caregiver credential flags replaced by a batched query; k6 retest p95 2.1 s.

Title: A second POST of a visit note after the 24-hour lock overwrote the narrative instead of returning 409
Resolution: Lock enforced in the documentation service, not only in the UI; API returns 409 DOC_NOTE_LOCKED and directs the user to add an addendum.

Title: Schedule form showed the raw error code "SCH_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED" instead of a message
Resolution: UX Designer wrote problem-and-fix messages for every compliance-check code; a lint rule fails the build when a code has no catalog message.

Title: SMS escalations failed in staging because the shared SMS test credentials were rate-limited
Resolution: Staging moved to a dedicated SMS test sub-account; CI uses the SMS stub. Retry behavior retested with injected 503 responses.

Title: Escalation ladder rejected a step delay of 0 minutes; pilot agencies need an immediate first step
Resolution: SRS was silent on the minimum delay. BA confirmed with the three pilot Agency Administrators and the Product Owner: step 1 may be 0 minutes; later steps are at least 1 minute after the previous step. Acceptance note added to FR-NTF-03 in SRS v1.2 on 2026-06-12; fix in v1.0.0-rc.5; retested in UAT round 2.

Title: Adult-day participant with two check-ins on one day was billed two daily charges
Resolution: Daily-rate pricing now groups Verified visits by client, authorization and tenant-local calendar day.

Title: Overdue alert for a 20:00 dose was held by quiet hours until 07:00
Resolution: BR-053 listed "missed dose" as urgent but not the Overdue step of BR-030, so evening doses lost their first alert. BA, Clinical SME and Product Owner agreed every step of the dose escalation is urgent. Note added to BR-053 in SRS v1.2 on 2026-06-12; fix in v1.0.0-rc.5; evening timeline added to TC-MAR-004 and passed in UAT round 2.

Title: Supported-living proration used the previous month's day count: $6,200.00 x 21/31 = $4,200.00 instead of 21/30 = $4,340.00
Resolution: Divisor is now the number of days in the billing month; admission and discharge months covered by engine cases.

Title: Time-off impact list omitted visits on the request end date
Resolution: End date handled as an inclusive tenant-local date.

Title: Monthly MAR grid PDF cuts the day-31 column on Letter paper
Resolution: Accepted as a known issue at go/no-go on 2026-06-26. Workaround: print on Legal landscape. Planned for R1.2.

Title: At 200% font on a 5.5-inch Android 10 phone the Clock in button sits below the fold, so clock-in takes 4 interactions instead of 3
Resolution: Accepted as a known issue at go/no-go. Workaround: sticky Clock in button behind a feature flag, enabled for caregivers who use large text. Next-visit card redesign planned for R1.2.

Title: Open-shift lane count on the schedule board does not refresh after a claim until the page is reloaded
Resolution: Cosmetic; data is correct after refresh. Accepted at go/no-go; fix in progress for R1.2.
